pre_output_interface_fixes.reason: the first invocation stopped before output when exact collinearity in the frozen proxy span reached a nonsingular solver; the fix preserves the complete frozen span with a pseudoinverse and verifies that age adds one rank
the second invocation stopped before output because the age-identifiability gate was incorrectly applied to the geometry-only transfer fit; the fix limits that gate to a literal age predictor

primary_production_anchor.rule: both size-level two-orientation joint p values must be at least 0.01 and all four absolute slope retentions must be at most 0.25
primary_production_anchor.interpretation: the one-pass boundary/core/cut vector attenuates the N425 point estimates strongly but does not meet the common all-size/all-orientation absorption gate; N325 retains a large, jointly nonzero production-anchored age association

fresh_pilot.solver: Moore-Penrose least-squares on the full frozen column span; no proxy selected or dropped
fresh_pilot.H2_boundary: H2 is the one-step hazard sufficient statistic and remains a definition-level calibration ceiling, not an independent mechanism

cross_size_transfer.method: fit the complete N325 geometry-only span and transfer it without refitting to N425
cross_size_transfer.interpretation: the 20k transfer test is imprecise, but its residual effect sizes remain comparable to the production age slope rather than closing toward zero

claim_boundary: Failure to absorb excludes only this compact one-pass shape vector. It does not prove intrinsic temporal memory, complete-state non-Markovianity, or absence of a more targeted bottleneck coordinate. The N325 and N425 rows are separate size blocks, while orientations within size share their random stream.
